decisions.reason: Product A builds directly on the firm's established offer and shows a quantified cost-saving result, which the firm can interpret and build on given its related knowledge and R&D.
Product B is close to the firm's existing offer and has a dedicated website page, indicating it fits the firm's knowledge base and is being actively supported.
Product C builds on the firm's established offer and although only mentioned on the website, the firm's absorptive capacity allows it to learn from early market feedback and improve it.
Product D is close to the firm's established offer, and the firm's in-house R&D and cooperation give it the related knowledge to assimilate early results and keep the product.
